target_semantics_lesson: Forecast Alphabet Inc.'s quarterly revenue year-over-year growth acceleration for the fiscal quarter ending 2024-12-31, focusing on the change in growth rate.
evidence_selection_lesson: Validate causal bridges by requiring current, cutoff-safe evidence for each factor and link. Weak or missing evidence for any link reduces confidence in the entire chain.
causal_reasoning_lesson: Evaluate growth acceleration by testing chains from macroeconomic headwinds, competitor performance, and Google Cloud. Each link requires current support; test competing paths rigorously.
counterevidence_lesson: Consider AI investments as counterevidence. Assess if their impact on short-term revenue growth and profitability is significant enough to alter the primary causal path.
calibration_lesson: Calibrate forecasts by checking if current evidence supports each checkpoint transition and if magnitude/boundary evidence exists, not just directional indicators.
